content.title: Ocular Metrics for Fatigue Assessment: A Survey from Physiology to Machine Learning
content.abstract: Fatigue is pervasive and safety-critical, yet objective biomarkers remain limited, resulting in a gap between subjective reports and clinical decision-making. The eye provides a non-invasive readout of central nervous system function: changes in eyelid behaviour, eye movements, and pupillary dynamics track arousal, executive control, and visual strain. This PRISMA-guided, PROSPERO-registered review integrates work in medicine, psychology, and neuroscience with computational methods to map ocular biomarkers to fatigue phenotypes and their detection pipelines.
